[[File:LifeDay-MOTESB.png|thumb|right|250px|Chewbacca celebrates Life Day with his honor family]]
{{Quote|On Kashyyyk, I remember, we spoke of "honor families." They were bound as close as any child of your body.|Bowdaar|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''Wookiee honor family''' comprised a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee's]] true friends and boon companions, under a [[Life debt/Legends|special bond of friendship]] that joined one Wookiee with a group of other Wookiees, or even with members of other species.

Members of honor families pledged to lay down their lives for each other, and they extended this protection to the honor families of each individual member.

[[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] the Wookiee had a closely-intertwined relationship with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], such that there was no human word for that type of relationship, and considered himself head of a Wookiee Honor Family, willing to die for his partner.<ref name="Han Solo and the Lost Legacy">''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]''</ref> He later considered his companions, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and the droids [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], to be part of his honor family.
